question: 97: after an Offset that is not in px, does picking another Pin option keep the unit? Predicted before the read.
start: a new Shape on a probe page, Pin, Offset typed 5vh (as CAP-U4PINUNIT.json)

predicted.after: Remove Pin, then Pin to Top on Scroll

why: A slider move keeps the unit on the oracle (CAP-U4PINUNIT.json); a new option changes only the anchor. Remove Pin drops the offset, so a new pin starts at 0px.
ours: Ours keeps the number and drops the unit to px on a new option (97).
scored: Round 1 (CAP-U4PINTO.json): 1 of 3 option picks held. Center and Bottom read 0px, not 5vh; Top again read 5vh. Remove Pin closed the popover, so the last pick wasn't made.
